description: Sulaymaniyah Dec7 reports conflict on location (Education Directorate vs courthouse) and event linkage; one report says hundreds while the other is qualitative. Candidate is pending evidence and should not be treated as one verified event without reconciliation.

The Dec7 PUK Media page returned HTTP 403 when opened. This is an actual source denial; the exact receipt/body error is preserved and there was no retry. It does not establish anything about occurrence or turnout.

Al-Sadiq Dec16 engineers and Dec27 residents' gathering may or may not form one episode. Dec16 'dozens' and a 300-person cohort are separate; Dec27 sources conflict internally on dozens/hundreds. Threshold and government-vs-employer targeting remain unresolved.

The Dec30 Baghdad electricity protest is reported as 'dozens', so the 50-person simultaneous threshold is not established. An inadvertent duplicate open happened during capture persistence; it is one source/event, not corroboration, and request times remain unknown.

Historical access ledgers and complete aliases/origin list are absent. The source-checking helper indexes canonical source cards only; versioned staged cards were reviewed manually. Known pending holds (AP, HRW, New Arab, Facebook, L'Orient) were not reopened; no blanket clearance is implied.

Regional source searches cover a limited set of Basra and Sulaymaniyah items. No systematic province-by-province or Kurdish-language search, official MM baseline, or LexisNexis-equivalent coverage was completed.

Alsumaria Dec25 Basra lecturers' demonstration reports hundreds and an explicit Education Ministry appointment demand, but only one source was opened; independent corroboration and exact route/organizer/state response remain pending.
